theme: A quiet Portland Saturday with the booking clock running.
greeting: A clear Saturday, Dan — the Black Keys at noon and almost nothing else on the calendar. The thing worth catching before the week turns is a short stack of travel bookings whose windows are starting to close.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: The p1 board item: a full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out. A refundable hold costs nothing and removes the risk — open since mid-September.

needsAttention.title: December break — book by Oct 15
needsAttention.detail: Five days left on the book-by date for the 21-day holiday trip with all four girls, the thinnest inventory of the year. The domestic-vs-flexible-international call still needs to land first.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5-18 off-week gap is the window to drive the Pathfinder Portland to St Pete; once the two travel days are set, book the single hotel night.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review board sweep
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 9 AM 15-minute review with Mike runs off the 'Dan & Mike Stuff' board — a quick look at what's active and what's stalled is the agenda you'll walk in with.

flagged.title: Lunch with Fran next Friday
flagged.detail: She's happy with Miyake as long as there's something cooked — a final yes on place and the 12:30 time is all that's left.

inbox.noise: A Redbubble sale and a design newsletter — nothing that needs you.
inbox.clear: The rest of the inbox is quiet.
